homepage.projectDescription: Born of a personal journey, out of devotion and love for God, Genuflexio brings together the liturgical calendar and the artistic heritage it has inspired. Explore liturgical celebrations on any date of your choosing, trace the centuries through the lives of the saints, and contemplate the works of art — many of them masterpieces — dedicated to them.

celebration.title: Liturgical Celebrations
celebration.description: Discover each day's celebrations: their rank, liturgical colour, history and distinctive features. Freely browse the calendar, compare national calendars and explore the customs of the Roman tradition, shaped by centuries of worship.

calendars.title: Multiple Calendars
calendars.description: National calendars or the traditional calendar preceding 1962: compare liturgical practices and follow the one that best suits your observance. (Note: the 1960 calendar is still under development.)

saints.title: The Lives of the Saints
saints.description: Explore the lives of the saints, their titles, patronages and attributes. Discover the places that shaped their lives through a dedicated interactive map, and find inspiration and guidance in their example and witness.

gallery.title: The Sacred Art Gallery
gallery.description: Reflecting my personal appreciation for classical painting and the richness of Baroque art, this gallery brings together works in the public domain. Discover paintings dedicated to the saints and the great figures of the Christian tradition.

about.title: A calendar, a memory, a gallery.
about.lead: Genuflexio brings together the liturgical calendar and the artistic heritage it has inspired: the feast of the day, the lives of the saints, and the masterpieces created in their honour.

manifesto.title: Giving faces back to the calendar
manifesto.p1: Every day of the year bears a name, a story, a colour. For centuries, painters, sculptors and illuminators have given faces to these names. Genuflexio simply seeks to bring these connections back to life.
manifesto.p2: Created first and foremost to accompany Catholic practice, Genuflexio is a quiet space at the crossroads of faith, history and art. A place to discover the celebration of the day, walk in the footsteps of the saints across the centuries, and contemplate the masterpieces of sacred art they have inspired.
manifesto.quote: Not all those who wander are lost.

0.title: Accuracy
0.text: The calendar logic has been carefully built using reliable and verifiable sources. Nevertheless, should you have any doubts or wish to confirm something, I encourage you to consult your local diocese.

1.title: Openness
1.text: All artworks featured in the gallery are in the public domain. Given the size of the collection, I cannot guarantee that every detail is free of errors. I sincerely apologise in advance for any mistakes or inaccuracies.

2.title: Simplicity
2.text: No advertising, no commercialisation, no noise. Simply a page that does what it promises, created without personal gain, out of devotion.

credits.title: For the Salvation of Souls
credits.text: Genuflexio is an independent project, built entirely in my spare time, with the hope of helping me find my way back into professional life. It is a work born of passion and devotion. My heartfelt thanks to everyone who has supported and encouraged me along the way, especially the Domini family for their spiritual guidance, Saint-Georges parish, and Inès for her work on the logos. Feel free to visit my GitHub to discover my other projects.
